summary: This video covers the Eve of the Rift event and Faction Wars in Dragonheir: Silent Gods. Creator OddOneGaming advises pulling two copies of Child of Chaos for both the hero and exclusive artifact. He explains how to select top-tier heroes like Felosia or Synarell from the Fated Path Test and provides two active promo codes, including a 24-hour limited quiz code and a creator reward code.

heroes.name: Child of Chaos
heroes.note: Recommends pulling two copies to acquire both the hero and his artifact, despite a minor pre-release nerf.

heroes.name: Felosia
heroes.note: Obtainable by selecting 'A' answers in the Fated Path Test quiz event.

heroes.name: Synarell
heroes.note: Available as a choice alongside Felosia upon completing the Fated Path Test with 'A' answers.

meta_changes: Child of Chaos received a slight balance adjustment prior to release but remains exceptionally powerful across all elements.
tips: Aim for two copies of Child of Chaos to unlock both the hero and his signature artifact.
Redeem promo code LUMINARY (capitalized) within 24 hours before it expires.
Redeem promo code Fastidious13 to collect Wyrmarrow, Heliolite Dice, and daily rewards.
Select option 'A' throughout the web Fated Path Test to get a choice of Felosia or Synarell.
Log into the Riftbound All-Star Night event page to join the Dark Lady faction and bind your chosen God Envoy and Preacher.
